commentary.text: 90+7' Alejandro Hernandez is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Omar Alderete (Getafe) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
90+5' Alejandro Hernandez interrupts the game. One of the players from Getafe won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
90+4' The ball is behind the touchline and Getafe will take a throw-in.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Getafe players have a reason to celebrate!
90' Wait! Referee Alejandro Hernandez has indicated he is going to review the Getafe goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.

89' 3 - 2 Mason Greenwood sends a superb cross into the box. Jaime Mata (Getafe) latches on to it and from close range plants a header inside the right post, leaving Vicente Guaita beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 3:2.
87' Here is a change. Javier Manquillo is going off and Rafael Benitez gives the last tactical orders to Kevin Vazquez (Celta Vigo).
87' It is time for a substitution. Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) is on for Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez.
87' Substitution. Ilaix Moriba (Getafe) in, Nemanja Maksimovic out.
85' 2 - 2 Goal! Tadeo Allende (Celta Vigo) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Iago Aspas inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the roof of the net. 2:2.
84' Tadeo Allende (Celta Vigo) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the right post. David Soria is alert and denies him with a nice save.
84' The game is interrupted as Jaime Mata (Getafe) is flagged offside.
82' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Getafe, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
82' The foul by Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Alejandro Hernandez.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) comes onto the pitch for Renato Tapia.
80' Rafael Benitez decides to make a substitution. Jorgen Strand Larsen will be replaced by Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo).
78' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) produces a good strike that sails to the top right corner, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
77' A pass by Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
75' It's time for a substitution. Carles Alena (Getafe) comes on in place of Jordi.

68' The corner from Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is intercepted by the defence.

67' Flag up against Jaime Mata (Getafe). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.

58' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Celta Vigo.

28' Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) sends a teasing cross into the area, but David Soria intercepts the ball.
28' Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
26' David Soria displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
25' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.

11' A cross from a corner kick by Celta Vigo is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
9' Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
9' A player from Getafe takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Celta Vigo are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
8' Javier Manquillo (Celta Vigo) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
7' Javier Manquillo (Celta Vigo) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
